info.title: Motto
info.description: Refundable holds for agents renting real-world things and buying research. The agent holds the ceiling for that item, from $0.10 to $10.00, with x402 upto on Solana; GET /v1/terms lists them. The desk checks whether the need is already handled, then keeps the hold as the rental or returns it. Device checks cover a charger, hotspot, battery pack, storage and monitor. Research is a delivery, three DOI-backed citation records, and verify is a pure check of a condition you state.
info.x-guidance: Read GET /v1/terms first (free): it lists every item with hold_usd, check_fee_usd and the settlement rules. Then call POST /v1/rent/{item} through a payment-aware client. The first response is a 402 x402 upto offer for a hold of up to the ceiling for that item, from $0.10 to $10.00; GET /v1/terms lists them. The client pays and retries, and the desk settles by these rules: already handled or not delivered charges the check fee and returns the rest; delivered charges the whole hold (verify: the fee, since it is a pure check and the fee is charged on a definitive verdict either way); check failed or inconclusive charges nothing and returns the whole hold. Research is a delivery (three DOI-backed citation records) alongside the device checks, with no check fee. One call is one hold, so do not repeat a call that returned 200. Send an Idempotency-Key header: a retry with the same key and payer answers the same hold instead of opening a second one, while a retry after decision settle_failed opens a fresh hold. The Pay.sh sandbox occasionally rejects a payment with a transient facilitator error; the desk then reports settle_failed and charges nothing, so retry once.

items.description: Per item hold_usd, check_fee_usd, covers, charge_on_delivered (hold or fee), check question, params and settlement rules.

post.summary: Buy a verified three-source research pack
post.description: Holds up to $1.00, then fetches citation records for query from Crossref public metadata and checks that three distinct DOI-backed records with titles came back. Three records delivered: $1.00 charged, nothing returned. Incomplete result or provider unavailable: nothing charged, $1.00 returned. Check failed: nothing charged, $1.00 returned. There is no check fee on this item. A missing or invalid query is a 400 before any payment.

query.description: The research topic, 3 to 200 characters. The desk returns 3 citation records for it from Crossref public metadata.

example.query: refundable escrow for autonomous agent purchases

post.summary: Verify any condition before you buy, refundable $0.10 hold
post.description: Holds up to $0.10, which is also the check fee. You state the condition that would make a purchase unnecessary; the desk reads its device evidence and up to 3 public https URLs, and a model decides. This is a pure check: a definitive verdict either way, true or false, charges the $0.10 fee and returns nothing. Evidence does not settle it: nothing charged, $0.10 returned. Check failed: nothing charged, $0.10 returned. A missing or invalid condition is a 400 before any payment.

example.condition: The laptop has at least one external monitor connected
